_note: Lead engine rules (docs/melody-and-solo-brief.md §3, §5). Weights are costs: lower is better. Hard rules (scale, leaps, endings, fret limits, bends) are enforced in lib/melody.ts and proved by npm run verify. Owner decisions: intro fret limit 12, solo 15 (DECISIONS.md).
_chordTones: Intervals from the key root. I, IV and V take the major third; ii, iii and vi the minor third (brief §3).
_arcs: Register target per bar, in semitones from the key root (the root near the middle of the neck). 16-bar solos stretch the 8-bar arc.

techniques._note: Bends only from a scale note to a scale note, a whole step (or half step) up, on a held strong-beat note on the G, B or e string. Hammer-ons and pull-offs join two notes on one string 1-3 frets apart, the second on a weak beat. Slides join the last note of a phrase to the first of the next when the hand shifts along one string. Vibrato on solo notes held a quarter note or longer.
